sourceTitle: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
originalTitle: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.

blocks.text: What do Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin, and Ada Lovelace have to teach us about creativity in the age of AI?
blocks.zh: 在AI时代，列奥纳多·达·芬奇、本杰明·富兰克林和埃达·洛夫莱斯能教给我们哪些关于创造力的东西？
blocks.en: What do Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin, and Ada Lovelace have to teach us about creativity in the age of AI?

blocks.text: On our newest episode of Dialogues on Technology and Society, Kent Walker sits down with biographer and historian Walter Isaacson to talk about why history's biggest breakthroughs have always been a team sport. They look at why curiosity and human judgment matter more than ever when information is right in your pocket.
blocks.zh: 在我们最新一期的 Dialogues on Technology and Society 节目中，Kent Walker 与传记作家兼历史学家 Walter Isaacson 坐下来探讨为什么历史上最重大的突破始终是一项团队运动。他们探讨了当信息就在你的口袋里时，为什么好奇心和人类判断力比以往任何时候都更重要。
